independence: Fresh context-free delegated designer. No product source, diff, new candidate results, or implementer algorithm explanations were inspected. Expectations precede any new product execution.
task_input: User objective/public requirements, policy name roles, public Player/API/CLI/battle-lab entry points, registered two-deck snapshots, approximate modeling and hidden-information boundary, K=3/5/10 comparison, bounded independent tests.
read_sources: src/svdeck/data/battle_example_replay.json (public exported schema and card definitions; one-line serialization also emitted existing random replay frames unintentionally, not new candidate output)
oracle_sources: Public declarative card effects and elementary hand-subset enumeration; no existing policy verdict or output is used as the expected answer.
design_limits: Three journeys, five synthetic probes, two registered-card metadata checks, one hidden-state metamorphic pair, two complete-game seat checks. Product source audit belongs to engineering validation; independent acceptance uses public behavior.
